spell.aurorion_magia.dolor_cruciatus.gui: Channel raw pain into a target in sight. While it lasts they bleed fast, the agony stops them walking and jumping, and no spell or item answers the hand of someone being tortured.
spell.aurorion_magia.imperium_mentis.gui: Impose your will on a mind. Creatures fight for you; people lose their bearings and cannot cast or use what they hold.
spell.aurorion_magia.vinculum_carnificis: Vinculum Carnificis. The spot where the target was struck becomes the anchor of an invisible chain. They walk, fight and cast freely — but crossing the line drags them back and makes them bleed, harder every time. Pearls and teleports do not save them.
spell.aurorion_magia.transpositio.guide: Transpositio. You and the target swap places in an instant — and swap speed and fall as well. Save an ally, trap an enemy or escape a siege.
spell.aurorion_magia.manus_carnificis.gu: Manus Carnificis. Hold a creature in the air and steer it with your gaze. Release to hurl it — hitting a wall hurts.
spell.aurorion_magia.manus_vacua.guide: Manus Vacua. Rip the item from the target's hand and throw it to the ground. While sneaking, takes the off-hand instead: shield, totem, focus.
spell.aurorion_magia.genua_flecte.guide: Genua Flecte. "Bend the knee." The target drops to their knees before you: barely able to move, no jumping, no sprinting, nothing in their hands works and no spell comes out — but they can still speak. Cast again on them to let them rise.
spell.aurorion_magia.vox_interdicta.guid: Vox Interdicta. Take someone's voice. Nothing they say is heard, in chat or out loud, and no spell leaves their mouth. Cast again on the same target to give the voice back.
spell.aurorion_magia.sigillum_clausum.gu: Sigillum Clausum. Seal a door, trapdoor, gate, chest, barrel, a backpack on the ground, or anything with an inventory — including other mods'. Nobody opens, breaks or carries it away except you and, with more mastery, your team. A seal of equal or higher level breaks yours.
spell.aurorion_magia.deiectio_corporis.g: Deiectio Corporis. A brutal force nails the target to the ground: no wings, no flight, no levitation. Sneaking, the wave opens around you and drops everything airborne within the radius. Anyone already grounded takes the impact and cannot jump for a moment.
spell.aurorion_magia.lux_vorata.guide: Lux Vorata. The light around you is devoured: candles, campfires, lamps and fire go out, and everyone inside the radius is left in Darkness — except you and your team.
spell.aurorion_magia.ferrum_ligatum.guid: Ferrum Ligatum. The target's armor and off-hand item are bound to their body: they won't come off, swap or drop.

aurorion_magia.mente_turva: Your mind is not your own. No spell answers.
aurorion_magia.corrente: The chain won't let you go.
aurorion_magia.nada_a_roubar: There is no motion to steal.
aurorion_magia.desarmado: Something tore away what you were holding.
aurorion_magia.ferro_vinculado: The iron closes over your body.
aurorion_magia.nada_a_lacrar: There is nothing here that can be sealed.
aurorion_magia.lacre.resisted: The seal holds: a stronger hand made it.
aurorion_magia.lacre.full: There are too many seals in this world.
spell.aurorion_magia.tempus_sistere.guid: Tempus Sistere. Forbidden spell. Everything around you stops — people, creatures, arrows in flight — except you. No one moves, strikes or uses anything; they can only look. Radius and duration grow with mastery.
spell.aurorion_magia.mortem_dico.guide: Mortem Dico. Forbidden spell. "I declare death." The target dies at once: no armour, enchantment, shield or totem saves them. From the second level on, cast while sneaking, a pentagram opens on the ground and kills everything inside it — allies included.
spell.aurorion_magia.dolor_universus.gui: Dolor Universus. Forbidden spell. Everyone around you is lifted off the ground and held there, paralysed with pain, bleeding for as long as you hold the spell, with lightning falling around the seal. Radius, height and pain grow with mastery.

spell.aurorion_magia.aspectus_captus.gui: Aspectus Captus. "Look at me when I am talking to you." The target's gaze is locked on you: they walk slowly and speak, but cannot turn away. Sneaking, a huge eye opens above you and the whole square is forced to stare.
spell.aurorion_magia.mundus_vacuus.guide: Mundus Vacuus. Take the world away from someone. The target stops seeing every person and creature around — they are all still there, talking and striking, but to them the place is deserted. Cast again on the same target to give the world back.
ui.aurorion_magia.alternar: Cast again on the same target to undo
aurorion_magia.dor_demais: The pain lets no word out.
aurorion_magia.de_joelhos: On your knees, your hands do not obey.

spell.aurorion_magia.submersio.guide: Submersio. Fill someone's lungs with water on dry land. Their air runs out, the body grows heavy and the drowning begins - and everything that saves you from a dive saves you here: Respiration, a potion, milk. Cast it again on the same target to give the air back.
spell.aurorion_magia.unda_magna.guide: Unda Magna. A wall of water bursts out of you and throws everything away, dousing anyone on fire and sweeping even arrows out of the air. Standing, it opens in the arc ahead of you; sneaking, in every direction at once.
spell.aurorion_magia.carcer_aquae.guide: Carcer Aquae. A sphere of water closes around the target and holds them in place: they cannot walk, flee or be carried away - but they still breathe, see and hear. Any blow from outside bursts the bubble and frees them.
spell.aurorion_magia.ventus_custos.guide: Ventus Custos. Everyone around you is hurled out of the circle, and a wall of wind stays where you stood: anyone trying to enter is pushed back, harder every time. It does not heal and does not stop damage - what it buys is distance.
spell.aurorion_magia.columna_venti.guide: Columna Venti. An updraft rises from the ground wherever you look. Whoever steps into it is lifted and comes down light. It harms no one and picks no side: your enemy rises just as easily as you do.
spell.aurorion_magia.turbo_ventorum.guid: Turbo Ventorum. A funnel of wind forms ahead of you and travels in a straight line, dragging everything in its path toward its axis and hurting whoever cannot get out. It breaks apart the moment it meets a wall.

passive.aurorion_magia.manus_medica.guid: Each melee hit restores half a heart and slowly heals the worst injury without taking health. The target feels the impact and recoils; several hits are needed for a full recovery.
passive.aurorion_magia.presenca_terrivel: Anyone nearby feels fear: the world goes dark, the screen closes in black, the heart races and a black mist pours off you. Everyone around drops to the ground, and creatures flee. Switch it on and off with /aurorion passivas.
aurorion_magia.passiva_como_ligar: Switch it on and off with %s
item.aurorion_magia.pergaminho_passiva.a: Reading consumes the scroll. The mark stays with the character.
commands.aurorion_magia.passiva_sem_inte: %s has no switch: it is always on.
